name: @recx/exam-browser
description: REC Exam Browser. A kiosk browser a candidate launches for one paper and quits afterwards. Holds NO database URL and NO college secret: the only credential it ever sees is a launch token for one sitting, exchanged for a key it keeps in memory. Installs no service, no scheduled task and no autostart entry, and leaves nothing running when the sitting ends (docs/EXAM-BROWSER.md).
author: Rajalakshmi Engineering College
